
{{alias}}( c )
    Returns the expected value of a double Weibull distribution.

    If `c <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `c` is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    c: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Mode.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    0.0
    > v = {{alias}}( 4.0 )
    0.0
    > v = {{alias}}( 8.0 )
    0.0
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
